modification.purpose: Use node-specific V4L2 device_caps when advertised; reject metadata-only siblings through the ordinary capture-capability check.

configuration.linkage: Static ELF executable; no PT_INTERP or PT_DYNAMIC program header.

qualification.arm64: Built and exercised in an isolated aarch64 Linux VM.
qualification.x64: Built and exercised under existing x86_64 instruction translation in that aarch64 Linux VM; not native x64 hardware validation.
qualification.capture: Real encoder, process, pipes, handoff, bounded WebM sink, PNG snapshot and closure with synthetic input. USB identity and capability inputs were mocked.
qualification.hardware: No physical Linux capture, USB audio, long-duration capture or rendered UI acceptance.
qualification.reproducibility: Pinned upstream source archives and build recipes are provided. Bit-for-bit reproducibility with a changed toolchain is not claimed.
qualification.signing: No publisher signing, notarization, patent or legal-clearance claim.
